en.headline: Observatory updates Strong Monsoon Signal with easterly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force with strong easterly winds expected and occasional gale-force gusts.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory updated the Strong Monsoon Signal at 9.45am on Monday, confirming it remains in force.
The Observatory said strong winds with mean speeds exceeding 40 kilometres per hour are expected from the east, with gusts occasionally reaching gale force.

People not well sheltered from the east were advised to take precautions against strong gusty winds and secure objects that could be blown away. Those planning water sports or sea operations were urged to take special care, as conditions are particularly rough over offshore waters.

zh.headline: 天文台更新強烈季候風信號 吹偏東強風
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，強烈季候風信號現正生效，預料吹偏東強風，陣風間中達烈風程度。
body: 香港天文台於周一上午9時45分更新強烈季候風信號，確認信號現正生效。
天文台指，預料本港吹偏東強風，平均風速每小時超過四十公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
未受良好遮擋的市民應採取預防措施，把花盆及其他可能被吹走的物件移入室內。計劃進行水上運動或海上工作的人士須特別小心，離岸海域風浪尤其大。
